name: Comte de Artois
source:
"Crown Princess, you should pay more attention to your surroundings. With one word people would die for you, you know?"

Born in France.
Hobby: Being Amused
Likes: Being Amused
Dislikes: Boredom

The one in control of the region of Artois.
An optimistic and surprisingly family minded person, but he has an exclusive way of thinking.
He's Louis XVI and the Count of Provence's younger brother, but he's the most reliable one among them.
One one hand he thinks that there's a time to have fun and that's fine, but he still worries about Louis XVI and Marie.
